source.title: The hippocampal-VTA loop: controlling the entry of information into long-term memory.

confidence_rationale: Foundational, heavily-cited review that supplies BOTH a hippocampal novelty/mismatch detector (MECH-149) AND its VTA dopaminergic gain partner (MECH-075) as one coupled loop. Confidence capped because it is a theoretical/review synthesis, and because REE repurposes the novelty gate to inject PLANNING rollouts whereas the paper's loop gates entry into long-term memory.
failure_signatures: The loop is framed around gating MEMORY STORAGE (LTP/entry into LTM), not around gating proposal injection into a planner. REE's use of CA1 mismatch to modulate rollout frequency/diversity is an extrapolation of the same novelty signal to a different consumer.

mapping.source_claim_statement: The hippocampus detects newly-arrived information not already in long-term memory; this novelty signal travels via subiculum/accumbens/ventral pallidum to the VTA, whose novelty-dependent dopamine firing is fed back to the hippocampus to enhance LTP and learning -- a closed hippocampal-VTA loop.
mapping.ree_translation: Grounds MECH-149's CA1 mismatch/novelty detector (the hippocampus computing 'is this already stored/predicted?') and, in the same loop, MECH-075's claim that VTA dopaminergic gain modulates hippocampal attractor dynamics. The two REE claims are not independent -- the biology presents them as one feedback circuit, so the completion-set partner of MECH-149 (the VTA gain arm = MECH-075) is grounded here too.
mapping.mapping_caveat: The loop gates ENTRY INTO LONG-TERM MEMORY (what gets stored). MECH-149 repurposes the same novelty signal to gate ROLLOUT INJECTION into E3 evaluation (what gets simulated). The novelty-detection arm transfers cleanly; the downstream consumer differs.
mapping.source_context: Theoretical synthesis of rodent/primate anatomy and physiology (subiculum-accumbens-VP-VTA pathway; DA modulation of hippocampal LTP).

confidence_components.notes: Canonical review (high citation, foundational) rather than a single primary result -- source_quality strong but not primary-data. Mapping fidelity moderate: novelty-detection arm maps well; the planning-injection consumer is REE-specific. Grounds MECH-075 as the loop's gain partner.
